title: Modeling Political Discourse with Sentence-BERT and BERTopic
benchmark_measurement: Measurement of moral language in political discourse, particularly the 'Purity/Degradation' foundation of Moral Foundations Theory, which the paper links to religious narratives and concepts like the 'sanctity of life'.
findings: The Purity/Degradation moral foundation, influenced by religious narratives about sanctity, was found to be a component of political discourse. The paper notes that Social Conservatives typically rely on this foundation when discussing topics like the sanctity of life (abortion) and marriage. However, in the analyzed Twitter data from the 117th Congress, Democrats scored higher on Purity than Republicans. Additionally, the topic modeling identified a short-lived topic cluster related to 'Jewish celebrations'.
